mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, exceeding a 0.5% monthly decline, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies struggle with input disruptions and rising costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5%+ monthly INDPRO drop.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, especially when the level exceeds 6%, signals a weakening labor market and slowing consumer demand that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months when UNRATE exceeds 6%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise by more than 5% over the past 3 months, it signals strengthening consumer demand that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of periods following a 5%+ rise in HOUST over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales fall by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a sharp drop in consumer spending that will immediately weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of periods following a 1%+ monthly RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs month-over-month, it signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of periods following a > 100k MoM slowdown in PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that the Fed is behind the curve on, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as real yields collapse.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.
